Hi all,

Thanks — I ran the numbers. Attachment is a scoped breakdown (prorate_calc_20270327.pdf). Summary:
- Billing period: 2027-03-01 to 2027-03-31
- Add-on monthly fee (GPU Storage): EUR 6,000/month
- Removal effective: 2027-03-30 (2 days remaining in cycle)
- Daily rate: EUR 6,000 / 31 = EUR 193.55/day
- Credit for unused days (30th & 31st): 2 * EUR 193.55 = EUR 387.10 gross

VAT handling: since Novamed provided an EU VAT ID (EE102233445), we will apply reverse-charge on the pro-rated amount for services rendered in the EU. That means Redwood will zero-rate the VAT on our invoice and include the VAT reference on the billing memo; Novamed should account for the VAT under the reverse-charge regime. Please confirm the VAT ID in writing (attached VAT certificate preferred).

Refund vs credit: our standard practice for mid-cycle partials is to issue a credit note applied to the next invoice (faster bookkeeping), but we can process a direct refund if you prefer. Payment options:
- Refund to card on file: usually processed within 3-5 business days after approval.
- SEPA credit transfer: requires bank details (IBAN, BIC) and takes 2-5 business days; Redwood Finance charges no processing fee for SEPA.
- Wire (non-SEPA): possible but fees may apply — will need beneficiary bank details.

Please confirm: (A) whether you prefer a credit note or refund, (B) if refund, which method (card / SEPA / wire), and (C) upload the VAT certificate for our records.

Attachments: prorate_calc_20270327.pdf (spreadsheet with line items).
